image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sliced meatloaf on a light blue/grey plate. The loaf has a browned, textured exterior with a glossy red glaze (likely ketchup or tomato-based) dripping down the sides. The cut face reveals a dense, greyish-brown interior with visible flecks of green herbs and yellow/white inclusions (onions or breadcrumbs). The texture appears consistent with ground meat.
